# Roadroller, Blueberry's `intro-size` branch

Not from npm: copied from https://github.com/askeksa/roadroller, branch `intro-size`,
commit 8af6afa9ae5b9304b8d65ac53f6b2e4713824f7d (10 Oct 2026). It is Roadroller 2.1.0
(Kang Seonghoon, MIT, see LICENSE.txt) with Aske Simon Christensen's changes for intros:
float context predictions, one shared hash table, mixer weight sets, identifier contexts
(`-S w...`), a searched number of contexts and a smaller decoder.

Only what the CLI needs is here (cli.mjs and the modules it imports). build/build.py runs
`node cli.mjs` with the settings in build/roadroller.json; build/roadroller.py searches
new ones.
